policy_valid_values.name: policy_valid_values
policy_valid_values.value: "cancellation_policies"."reschedule_notice_hours" between 0 and 720 and "cancellation_policies"."notice_hours" >= 0 and "cancellation_policies"."late_fee_value" >= 0 and "cancellation_policies"."no_show_fee_value" >= 0 and "cancellation_policies"."late_fee_type" in ('percentage','fixed') and "cancellation_policies"."no_show_fee_type" in ('percentage','fixed') and ("cancellation_policies"."late_fee_type" <> 'percentage' or "cancellation_policies"."late_fee_value" <= 100) and ("cancellation_policies"."no_show_fee_type" <> 'percentage' or "cancellation_policies"."no_show_fee_value" <= 100)

booking_customer_or_guest.name: booking_customer_or_guest
booking_customer_or_guest.value:
("bookings"."source" = 'online' and "bookings"."user_id" is not null and "bookings"."guest_name" is null)
    or ("bookings"."source" in ('manual', 'walk_in') and "bookings"."user_id" is null and "bookings"."guest_name" is not null and "bookings"."payment_method_id" is null)

professional_price_bounds.name: professional_price_bounds
professional_price_bounds.value:
("professional_prices"."price_cents" between 0 and 10000000 or "professional_prices"."price_cents" is null)
    and ("professional_prices"."duration_minutes" between 1 and 720 or "professional_prices"."duration_minutes" is null)

appointment_payment_discount.name: appointment_payment_discount
appointment_payment_discount.value:
("appointment_payments"."discount_cents" = 0 and "appointment_payments"."discount_reason" is null)
    or ("appointment_payments"."kind" = 'settlement' and "appointment_payments"."discount_cents" > 0
      and "appointment_payments"."discount_reason" is not null and length(trim("appointment_payments"."discount_reason")) between 1 and 240)

appointment_payment_method.name: appointment_payment_method
appointment_payment_method.value:
("appointment_payments"."method" = 'cash' and "appointment_payments"."provider_reference" is null)
    or ("appointment_payments"."method" = 'simulated_card' and "appointment_payments"."provider_reference" is not null)

inventory_movement_values.name: inventory_movement_values
inventory_movement_values.value:
"inventory_movements"."balance" >= 0 and
    (("inventory_movements"."kind" = 'receipt' and "inventory_movements"."quantity" > 0) or ("inventory_movements"."kind" = 'adjustment' and "inventory_movements"."quantity" <> 0) or ("inventory_movements"."kind" = 'sale' and "inventory_movements"."quantity" < 0))

inventory_order_status.name: inventory_order_status
inventory_order_status.value:
("inventory_orders"."status" = 'open' and "inventory_orders"."closed_at" is null)
    or ("inventory_orders"."status" in ('received', 'cancelled') and "inventory_orders"."closed_at" is not null)

inventory_product_values.name: inventory_product_values
inventory_product_values.value: "inventory_products"."unit_cents" > 0 and ("inventory_products"."purchase_cost_cents" is null or "inventory_products"."purchase_cost_cents" between 0 and 10000000) and "inventory_products"."stock" >= 0 and "inventory_products"."reorder_at" >= 0

service_package_terms.name: service_package_terms
service_package_terms.value: "service_packages"."visits" between 2 and 50 and "service_packages"."price_cents" > 0 and "service_packages"."valid_days" between 1 and 730

saas_plan_values.name: saas_plan_values
saas_plan_values.value: "saas_plans"."monthly_cents" between 0 and 10000000 and "saas_plans"."location_limit" between 1 and 1000 and "saas_plans"."trial_days" between 0 and 90
